WITH s AS (
  SELECT f.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) rn FROM fact_sales_line f
), sales AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, sum(s.net_amount) gross_net FROM s JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=s.sale_date
  WHERE rn=1 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' GROUP BY 1
), ret AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) ret_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT a.store_id, ds.store_name, ds.sqm, ds.format, round(gross_net,2) gross_net, round(coalesce(ret_net,0),2) ret_net, round(gross_net-coalesce(ret_net,0),2) net, rank() over (order by gross_net-coalesce(ret_net,0) desc) rk
FROM sales a LEFT JOIN ret USING(store_id) JOIN (SELECT * FROM dim_store WHERE is_current) ds USING(store_id) ORDER BY net DESC LIMIT 16

WITH s AS (
  SELECT f.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) rn FROM fact_sales_line f
), x AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, s.net_amount amt FROM s JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=s.sale_date WHERE rn=1 AND st.store_id<900
  UNION ALL
  SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date WHERE st.store_id<900
), t AS (
  SELECT store_id, sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2024/25' THEN amt END) fy25, sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN amt END) fy26, sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN amt END) fy27, sum(amt) tot FROM x GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT t.store_id, store_name, round(fy25) fy25, rank() over (order by fy25 desc) r25, round(fy26) fy26, rank() over (order by fy26 desc) r26, round(fy27) fy27, rank() over (order by fy27 desc) r27, round(tot) tot, rank() over (order by tot desc) rt
FROM t JOIN dim_store ds ON ds.store_id=t.store_id AND ds.is_current ORDER BY fy26 DESC LIMIT 14

WITH dedup AS (
  SELECT f.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) AS rn
  FROM fact_sales_line f
), sales AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, sum(x.net_amount) AS sales_net
  FROM dedup x JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = x.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = x.sale_date
  WHERE x.rn = 1 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND st.store_id < 900 GROUP BY st.store_id
), refunds AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND st.store_id < 900 GROUP BY st.store_id
)
SELECT s.store_id, cur.store_name, round(s.sales_net - coalesce(rf.refund_net, 0), 2) AS net_sales_eur
FROM sales s LEFT JOIN refunds rf USING (store_id) JOIN dim_store cur ON cur.store_id = s.store_id AND cur.is_current
ORDER BY net_sales_eur DESC LIMIT 10
